set.title: Game: Trick-or-Treat Swap — Halloween swap-3 concept
set.body:
# Trick-or-Treat Swap — game concept

Halloween swap-3 (match-3) puzzle game for the gamiq monorepo. A kid in a costume
works their way down a spooky alley on Halloween night: **every door is a level,
every won level is a handful of candy** and one step further down the alley.

Sources: Royal Match power-up matrix (Rocket/TNT/Light Ball/Propeller + all 10
pairwise combos), Candy Crush blocker vocabulary, "45 Match-3 Mechanics"
(gamedeveloper.com).

## Core loop

- Swap two adjacent tiles, match 3+ of a kind, reach the level goal within the
  move limit.
- 6 tile types: Pumpkin (orange), Ghost (pale blue), Skull (bone), Bat (purple),
  Candy (pink), Potion (green).
- Leftover moves convert into score bursts → 1–3 stars per level.
- Win → the kid walks to the next door on the map and the door opens.

## Power-ups — all four unlocked by level 5

| Created by | Power-up | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| match 4 in a row/column | **Witch's Broom** | sweeps its row or column (direction of the match) |
| match 5 in an L/T shape | **Pumpkin Bomb** | carved, candle-lit pumpkin — 3×3 blast |
| match 5 in a straight line | **Magic Cauldron** | bubbling rainbow brew — swap with a tile to clear every tile of that color; tap to clear a random color |
| match a 2×2 square | **Little Ghost** | floats to the nearest objective tile and pops it |

## Combos — swap two power-ups together (taught gradually, levels 6–12)

| Swap | Result |
|---|---|
| Broom + Broom | **Cross Sweep** — clears the row AND the column |
| Broom + Ghost | ghost carries the broom to the densest row/column and sweeps it |
| Broom + Pumpkin | **Triple Sweep** — 3 rows + 3 columns |
| Broom + Cauldron | turns all tiles of the most common color into brooms and launches them |
| Ghost + Ghost | three little ghosts hit three objective tiles |
| Ghost + Pumpkin | ghost drops the pumpkin on the densest cluster (3×3) |
| Pumpkin + Pumpkin | **Giant Blast** — 5×5 explosion |
| Pumpkin + Cauldron | turns the most common color into pumpkin bombs that chain-detonate |
| Cauldron + Cauldron | **Night of the Witches** — clears the whole board and peels one layer off every obstacle |

## Obstacles — introduced one at a time, roughly every 4–6 levels

- **Cobweb** — 1–3 layers over a tile; match on the tile to peel it off.
- **Gravestone** — immovable cell occupant; match adjacent to break (1–3 hits).
- **Cursed Ice** — frozen tile; can't be moved until a match cracks it free.
- **Lock/Cage** — a tile locked in place; match its color to free it.
- **Slime** — creeping green goo; spreads one cell every few moves unless you
  match next to it (late-game pressure).

## Objectives (goal types)

1. **Fill the treat bag** — collect N tiles of given colors.
2. **Clear the cobwebs.**
3. **Break all gravestones / crack all cursed ice.**
4. **Free the caged ghosts** (trapped friends float away when freed).
5. **Deliver** — drop N goodies into the basket at the bottom of the board.
6. **Boss house** (chapter finale) — a greedy monster guards its candy; hit it
   with matches and power-ups while it throws new obstacles onto the board.

## Map & meta

One linear **alley map**: houses and doors on both sides, lampposts, fog, the
kid avatar walking door to door. Six chapters ("streets" of the neighborhood),
6–7 levels each, **~40 levels total** (range 30–50):

1. Maple Lane — suburb street; tutorial, all power-ups by level 5
2. Graveyard Path — cobwebs + gravestones
3. Witch's Hollow — cursed forest, cursed ice
4. Pumpkin Patch — slime + locks
5. Cemetery Hill — everything mixed, tighter move budgets
6. Castle Dracula Alley — finale, two boss houses

Each chapter ends in a boss house (vampire, witch, …).

## Teaching & difficulty curve

- L1–2: match-3 basics + collect goal.
- L3: Broom. L4: Pumpkin Bomb. L5: Cauldron + Ghost (2×2 rule), first combo
  teaser. *(Exact pacing is a tuning knob; hard requirement = all four by L5.)*
- L6–12: one combo per level, shown when it first naturally occurs.
- New obstacle every 4–6 levels, always in its easiest form first.
- Gentle ramp to L10, spikes at chapter-end bosses, breather level after each
  boss. Move budgets tuned against real completion rates (Playrix approach).

## Assets (per docs/assets.md)

6 tile sprites, 4 power-ups + combo FX, 5 obstacles, kid avatar (bob/walk),
per-chapter map strips, house/door art, boss portraits, UI (treat bag, moves,
stars). Chunky cartoon Halloween: deep purple/blue night palette, orange
accents, candle-lit glow. WebP, 2× budgets, transparent sprites, per-game
`ASSETS.md`.

## Tech

Scaffold with `pnpm new-game <slug>` from `games/tap-rush` (slug candidates:
`trick-or-treat`, `spooky-alley`). Levels as data-driven JSON in
`src/levels/`; board/pointer/loop/audio/storage from `@gamiq/shared`; progress
in shared storage helper.

## Phasing & out of scope (v1)

First playable milestone: chapter 1–2 (~13 levels) with full power-up set.
Deferred: pre-level boosters/consumables, lives/energy, events, IAD-style
economy. A simple idle-hint system is cheap and worth keeping.

set.title: Scaffold games/trick-or-treat-swap
set.body:
Bootstrap the Trick-or-Treat Swap game package from the tap-rush template (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- `pnpm new-game trick-or-treat-swap "Trick or Treat Swap"`
- Set `title`, `emoji` (🎃) and `description` in `games/trick-or-treat-swap/package.json`; verify the landing page picks them up.
- Skeleton `ASSETS.md` for the per-game asset inventory (see `docs/assets.md`).
- `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm build` all green.

set.title: Swap-3 board engine (core logic)
set.body:
Pure swap-3 core for ToTS, framework-free TypeScript (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- 6 tile types (pumpkin, ghost, skull, bat, candy, potion); seeded RNG for reproducible boards.
- Swap + match detection: 3-in-a-row, match-4 (→ Witch's Broom), L/T match-5 (→ Pumpkin Bomb), straight match-5 (→ Magic Cauldron), 2×2 square (→ Little Ghost). Power-up creation reported as events; their effects are the power-ups ticket's scope.
- Gravity/refill with cascades; no pre-made matches on board generation; valid-move check + reshuffle.
- Turn resolution as an event stream (created/cleared/converted) so render + audio animate from it; move accounting; win/lose evaluation hooks.

Acceptance: every match shape detected, cascades settle, illegal/locked swaps rejected, no-move boards reshuffle, unit tests green (add a test runner if the template lacks one).

set.title: Assets I: board art set
set.body:
Board art per `docs/assets.md`; per-game inventory in `games/trick-or-treat-swap/ASSETS.md` (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- 6 tile sprites: pumpkin, ghost, skull, bat, candy, potion — distinct hues, colorblind-safe, candle-lit cartoon Halloween (night purple/blue + orange accents).
- 4 power-ups: witch's broom, pumpkin bomb, magic cauldron, little ghost + activation/combo FX sheets.
- 5 obstacles: cobweb (1–3 layers), gravestone, cursed ice, lock/cage, slime.

Acceptance: WebP, 2× sizing budgets, transparent backgrounds; sprites replace placeholders in the play screen; ASSETS.md complete.

set.title: Assets II: map/meta art set
set.body:
Meta art per `docs/assets.md`, same style block as the board set (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Alley map strip per chapter (6 themed backdrops: Maple Lane, Graveyard Path, Witch's Hollow, Pumpkin Patch, Cemetery Hill, Castle Dracula Alley), house/door nodes, lampposts, fog overlays.
- Kid avatar: walk/bob frames + win moment.
- Boss portraits (vampire, witch, +4 per chapter), treat bag, stars, HUD frames.

Acceptance: map screen + HUD fully dressed; same WebP/2×/transparent budgets.

set.title: Power-ups: broom, pumpkin bomb, cauldron, ghost
set.body:
The four power-ups on the engine's event stream (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Witch's Broom (match-4): clears its row or column, direction of the match.
- Pumpkin Bomb (L/T match-5): 3×3 blast.
- Magic Cauldron (straight match-5): swap with a tile → clears every tile of that color; tap → random color.
- Little Ghost (2×2): homes to the nearest objective tile and pops it.
- Activation by tap or swap; power-ups occupy board tiles and are consumed by their effect; a power-up × power-up swap raises a distinct combo event (effects live in the combos ticket).

Acceptance: each creation shape yields the right power-up; each effect clears exactly its footprint/selection; unit tests per power-up.

set.title: Obstacles: cobweb, gravestone, ice, lock, slime
set.body:
Five blockers with layer/interaction rules (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Cobweb: 1–3 layers over a tile; matches on the tile peel one layer.
- Gravestone: immovable cell occupant; adjacent matches/power-ups break it (1–3 hits); no tile spawns there until cleared.
- Cursed Ice: frozen tile — can't be swapped until an adjacent match cracks it free.
- Lock/Cage: locks a tile in place; match its color to free it.
- Slime: spreads to an adjacent cell every N moves unless a match happens next to it; occupies the cell until cleared.

All must interact correctly with every power-up/combo (power-ups peel layers, hit gravestones inside their footprint, etc.) and be expressible in level JSON.

Acceptance: unit tests per obstacle + the power-up interaction matrix.

set.title: Level format + goal system + stars
set.body:
Data-driven level system (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- JSON level schema: grid shape mask, moves, spawn weights, tile types, obstacle placement, goal list, star thresholds.
- Goal types: collect N of a color; clear all cobwebs; break all gravestones/cursed ice; free all caged tiles; deliver N items to the bottom; boss (hook only — mechanic is the boss ticket).
- Loader + validation; goals evaluate from engine events; stars from moves left; win = all goals met, lose = moves out.
- L1–L5 placeholder levels sufficient to exercise the schema.

Acceptance: schema documented (ticket or LEVELS.md), invalid levels fail loudly, goal evaluation unit-tested.

set.title: Play screen: render, input, FX, audio
set.body:
The game screen on @gamiq/shared primitives (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Canvas board renderer driven by the engine event stream: swap, clear, gravity, cascades, power-up launches, combo FX.
- Touch-only input, mobile-first: tap-select + tap-neighbor or drag to swap; tap to activate power-ups; respects safe-area insets + setupViewport(), any orientation.
- Juice: particles, screen shake on bombs, candle-glow accents, audio unlocked on first gesture, idle hint after ~5s.
- HUD: moves left, goal chips, treat-bag counters, pause/quit, win/lose overlays with stars.
- Placeholder art acceptable initially; real sprites land via Assets I.

Acceptance: placeholder L1–5 playable on a phone at a solid framerate.

set.title: Power-up combos: 10-pair matrix
set.body:
All 10 pairwise power-up combos (swap two power-ups together), exactly the concept matrix (epic 9pbwcw):

- Broom+Broom: cross sweep — row AND column.
- Broom+Ghost: ghost carries the broom to the densest row/column and sweeps it.
- Broom+Pumpkin: triple sweep — 3 rows + 3 columns.
- Broom+Cauldron: most common color → launched brooms.
- Ghost+Ghost: three ghosts hit three objective tiles.
- Ghost+Pumpkin: pumpkin dropped on the densest cluster (3×3).
- Pumpkin+Pumpkin: giant blast — 5×5.
- Pumpkin+Cauldron: most common color → chain-detonating pumpkin bombs.
- Cauldron+Cauldron: full-board clear + one layer off every obstacle.

Acceptance: each pair resolves per matrix incl. layered-obstacle interaction; combos emit animatable events; unit tests cover all 10.

set.title: Alley map + progression meta
set.body:
The alley map screen + progression (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Single scrolling alley strip: door nodes per level on both sides, lampposts, fog; kid avatar walks to the next door on win with a door-open + candy moment.
- Chapter segments with themed backdrops (Maple Lane → Graveyard Path → Witch's Hollow → Pumpkin Patch → Cemetery Hill → Castle Dracula Alley); boss houses as chapter finals.
- Progress in shared storage: unlocked level, stars per level, current chapter; tap an unlocked door to play.
- Placeholder art fine; map strips arrive with Assets II.

Acceptance: progress survives reload, stars render, avatar walks on advance.

set.title: Boss house mechanic
set.body:
Chapter-finale boss levels (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Boss portrait above/behind the board with HP; matches adjacent to the boss and power-up hits deal damage.
- Every X moves the boss throws an obstacle onto the board (type per chapter).
- Win = boss HP 0 before moves run out; chapter-end celebration moment.
- Boss stats/behavior data-driven in level JSON: hp, throw interval, thrown obstacle type.

Acceptance: one boss level per behavior knob playable; logic unit-tested.

set.title: Tutorial & teaching flow
set.body:
Teaching flow (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Scripted, skippable overlays: L1–2 basics; L3 broom; L4 pumpkin bomb; L5 cauldron + ghost + first combo teaser.
- L6–12: one combo taught per level, presented when the player first can (or does) build both halves.
- First-obstacle popups: one-liner + highlight when an obstacle appears for the first time.
- Declarative tutorial-step format (trigger → highlight → text → await) in level JSON so content tickets can author steps.

Acceptance: full L1–12 path runs without dead ends; steps skippable; seen-tutorials persist via storage flag.

set.title: Content: chapters 1-2 (first playable)
set.body:
Author + tune chapters 1–2 (~13 levels) — the first playable milestone (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Maple Lane L1–7: basics, all four power-ups by L5, first combo, cobwebs late in the chapter; ends in the first boss house.
- Graveyard Path L8–13: cobwebs + gravestones, collect/deliver goals mixed; second boss.
- Move budgets tuned by playtesting each level: winnable with 1–2 moves spare on a decent line, 3 stars reachable but not free.

Acceptance: 13 levels, teaching curve per the concept, full loop playable start → finish on a phone, `pnpm build` green.

set.title: Content: chapters 3-6 + balance & ship
set.body:
Author + tune chapters 3–6 (~27 levels) to the full ~40, then the ship pass (concept: epic 9pbwcw):

- Witch's Hollow (cursed ice), Pumpkin Patch (slime + locks), Cemetery Hill (mixed, tight budgets), Castle Dracula Alley (finale, two boss houses).
- Difficulty arc: spikes at bosses, breather after each; every new obstacle introduced in its easiest form first.
- Ship pass: difficulty-curve review across all levels, perf pass on a mid phone, landing-page blurb, idle-hint tuning.

Acceptance: 40±10 levels done, per-level difficulty targets documented, QA checklist green.
